simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to צִנּוּר (H6794) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: צִנּוּר (tsinnûwr) means a culvert First listed occurrence: 2Sam 5 8.

definitions.full: H6794. tsinnuwr צִנּוֺר noun masculine pipe, spout, conduit (so Late Hebrew); — absolute בַּצִּנּוֺר וְיִגַּע 2Sam 5:8 (i.e., si vera lectio, of Jerusalem, but very dubious, compare Dr HPS); plural suffix צִנּוֺרֶיךָ קוֺל Psa 42:8 the sound of thy (water-) spouts figurative, of sluices of heaven opened, compare מֶּלֶג אֲרֻבֶּה, .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow ;
